seller_text: I can quickly compare your current plan with ours.
customer_text: I do not have time right now.

seller_text: We may be able to lower your monthly bill.
customer_text: The price is exactly what I am worried about.

seller_text: Do you know which provider you use today?
customer_text: I think it is the same one we have always used.

seller_text: There is no long binding on the new plan.
customer_text: Wait, is there a contract or binding period?

seller_text: The switch can be handled for you.
You would keep the same core service.
customer_text: I tried switching before and it became more expensive later.

seller_text: Can I ask who you use today?
The offer includes support and setup.
customer_text: I am worried support will be worse than what I have now.

seller_text: Most customers use less data than they expect.
customer_text: I probably do not use that much data.

seller_text: The plan is flexible if your usage changes.
customer_text: What happens if I need more data next month?

seller_text: I can send the numbers after the call.
It should only take a few minutes to check.
customer_text: I am busy, but if it is actually cheaper I can listen.
